example.title: Tiskilwa Bridge, Township Road 236 over Bureau Creek
example.place: Tiskilwa vicinity, Arispie Township, Bureau County, IL

brief: Three-span township-road crossing, 194 ft overall: a 119 ft, eight-panel pin-connected Pratt through truss (1884) in the middle, a later 60 ft Pratt pony truss on the north and a short 15 ft timber-stringer span on the south. Trusses 15.5 ft apart with 14 ft clear between the rails, 16.75 ft chord-to-chord and 13.7 ft portal clearance; laced channel top chords with cover plates, eyebar bottom chords; transverse timber plank deck with steel tread-plate wheel runners; the main span sits on riveted iron caissons (tube piers) with 1930s concrete caps, and one end rests on a cut-stone abutment. Wide, shallow, stony creek in bare-tree bottomland on a gravel country road.

traits.abutments: cut stone and iron caisson piers with concrete caps
traits.deck: timber plank with steel tread-plate runners
